children: India’s markets regulator may propose changes to equity derivatives settlement pricing after feedback that the new closing-auction system triggered sharp price swings, according to Bloomberg.
The Securities and Exchange Board of India is reviewing the pricing method after the auction process led to volatility in settlement levels.

title: India’s SEBI May Revise Options Settlement Pricing After Closing Auction Swings
